requirements.text: The system shall manage a hierarchical price configuration structure: Price Book → Price Category → Price Header → Price Item
Price Book shall be the top-level price configuration entity and shall be versioned
Price Category shall organize prices by Service Line within a Price Book
Price Header shall define parent/child grouping structures to organize Price Items
Price Item shall be the actual price record, containing price values (Price 1, Price 2) and belonging to a specific Price Book, Price Category, and Price Header
Users shall be able to view a list of all Price Book records
Users shall be able to create a new Price Book via an Add action
Users shall be able to create a new Price Book by copying an existing one and modifying it (Copy to Add)
Users shall be able to edit an existing Price Book
Users shall be able to delete (Remove) an existing Price Book
Users shall select a Price Book before the system loads associated Price Categories
Users shall be able to view, create (Add/Copy to Add), edit, and delete Price Categories
When creating a Price Category, users shall select one or more Service Lines from a defined enumeration
Users shall select a Price Book, then a Price Category, before the system loads associated Price Headers
Price Headers shall support a parent/child grouping structure, including a parent-header reference and a hierarchy-depth level
Users shall be able to view, create (Add/Copy to Add), edit, and delete Price Headers
Users shall select a Price Book, Price Category, and Price Header (plus optional Price Area filter) before the system loads associated Price Items
Users shall be able to view, create (Add/Copy to Add), edit, and delete Price Items
A new record's ID shall be system-assigned as (current maximum existing ID for that type) + 1 and shall not be user-entered
A new record (via Add or Copy to Add) shall default to version 0; each subsequent edit-save shall increment the version by 1
ID and Version fields shall become read-only once a record exists
Price Category/Header/Item selection shall follow a cascading dependency (Book → Category → Header → Item)

Each entity's management screen shall include a list section (with type-specific columns), Add/Copy to Add/Edit/Remove action buttons, a tabbed detail section (Data, Effective Info, Currently Version Info, Original Version Info), and a Close button
Price Item's Data tab shall include several boolean business-flag fields (Is Discountable, Is Discontinued, Is Product, Is Internal, plus two fields flagged as ambiguous in the source transcript)
